description: This Java class, ExistingVisitAssignmentHandler, is part of the OpenMRS API and handles assigning encounters to existing visits without creating new visits. It overrides specific methods to determine the appropriate visit for an encounter based on temporal and location criteria.

classes.name: ExistingVisitAssignmentHandler
classes.description: Handler class that assigns an encounter to an existing visit based on specific criteria, extending BaseEncounterVisitHandler.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the handler, localized according to the provided Locale.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter
methods.description: Assigns an existing visit to the encounter if suitable one is found, based on visit start and stop times and location hierarchy.

search-terms: Recognition of encounters within existing visits
